name: pickup_spawn_at
description: Pickup::SpawnAt creates a pickup object, applies the terrain variant and world transform, creates and links the spawn definition, and copies the created object name into the spawn record.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the Pickup spawn/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41da20 validates the CreateObjectInstance call, null return, SetVariantFromTerrain call, position and nullable rotation setters, CreateSpawnDefAndLink with linkToScene 1, and the final inline strlen/memcpy copy from pickupObj->name to PickupSpawnDef::name at offset 0x38.

The native pickup leaf smoke verifies successful spawn creation from a template, transform propagation, terrain variant assignment, primary-list linkage, scene linkage, pickup metadata, and copied spawn name.
